definitions.explanation: A duration of 100 years. Used both literally for measured time and figuratively for 'a very long time' in set expressions.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧{百年|ひゃくねん}だ。
examples.english: This shop has been in business for one hundred years.

examples.japanese: {百年|ひゃくねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}った→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: Rain that only falls once in a century fell.

examples.japanese: {百年|ひゃくねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{想像|そうぞう}→想像：02489_souzou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦できなかった→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧になっている。
examples.english: Technology that was unimaginable a hundred years ago is now taken for granted.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {百年|ひゃくねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: a hundred years ago
- {百年|ひゃくねん}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: a hundred years from now
- {百年|ひゃくねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧: once in a century
- ⟦{創業|そうぎょう}→創業：11792_sougyou⟧{百年|ひゃくねん}: founded a hundred years ago

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {百年|ひゃくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{恋|こい}→恋：02208_koi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{冷|さ}める→冷める：02114_sameru⟧: even a hundred-year love cools — used when one moment destroys a long-built feeling
- {百年|ひゃくねん}⟦{早|はや}い→早い：00514_hayai⟧: a hundred years too early — dismissive: 'you're nowhere near ready'
